target_customer: Non-developers and builders who use Claude or ChatGPT to make apps
problem: AI-built apps need backend, database, hosting and publishing; Floot provides that infrastructure so the user's own AI subscription builds the app.
business_model: Flat platform plans for infrastructure, with optional credits for its own agent and image generation

founders.name: Yujian Yao
founders.background_notes: YC page: staff engineer who rebuilt Retool's runtime, earlier early engineer at Asana; gold medalist in the Singapore informatics olympiad

technical_complexity.rationale: Hosting, database and publishing infrastructure behind MCP connectors is standard cloud engineering with integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Hosted apps and data create some lock-in, but well funded builders like Lovable and Replit overlap.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors grew rapidly; Base44 was reportedly acquired by Wix in 2025 per a secondary source. No acquisition of Floot found.

market_need_then: Vibe coding demand rose sharply in 2025, with builders needing hosting and backend; Floot-specific demand not independently documented.

brand_strength.rationale: Customer showcase pages and Product Hunt launches exist, but little press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Floot is a one-founder company in the crowded AI app builder market that repositioned as the app platform inside Claude and ChatGPT, launching an MCP connector around September 2026. No verified funding, revenue or exit is public, so its outcome is unknown.
notes: Unverified funding: VCBacked pre-seed July 2025 undisclosed with Y Combinator, Pioneer Fund, Team Ignite, Lombardstreet; FundedIQ $500K; another directory $630K. A search snippet names a co-founder Edward Look but the YC page lists one founder, so he is not recorded. Dated competitor search found only 2026 comparisons. Product shift to MCP connector is described by aggregators.
